title: Verification Result
description: Tri-state verification outcome with per-check evidence and a recommended action. REVIEW and FAIL are never silent; FAIL carries a bounded restore budget via the recommended action. Minimal example: {"schema_version": "verification-result/0.1", "status": "PASS", "checks": [{"id": "citations_resolve", "passed": true, "detail": "3 of 3 citations resolve"}], "confidence": 0.9, "recommended_action": "PASS"}. Transcribed from docs/msi/05-msi-spec-v0.md section 4.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier and version. Must equal verification-result/0.1.

status.description: Tri-state outcome: PASS, REVIEW or FAIL.

checks.description: Per-check evidence. Deterministic checks run before any model-scored check.

failures.description: Failure descriptors when status is REVIEW or FAIL.

recommended_action.description: Closed action vocabulary. Single re-verify only, no unbounded loop.
